name: Transtech Optelecom Science Holdings Limited
summary: Transtech Optelecom Science Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacturing and sale of optical fibre cables, optical cable cores, and related products. The company also designs and manufactures specialty optical fibre cables, including rodent resistant optical fibre cable, flame-retardant optical fibre cable, and non-metallic optical fibre cable. In addition, it sells optical cable cores and other related products comprising power cable and other auxiliary products. Further, the company offers optical fibre coloring, secondary coating, and stranded cabling, as well as the tests. It has operations in China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Malaysia, Myanmar, Thailand,…
